source_chain.note: The May Gazette is a future-effective amendment as at 16 October 2026. Current baseline is Version IX plus any other separately operative sources. Do not silently activate Gazette values, infer all remaining products are unaffected, or equate first-source match with compliance.

amendment_provisions.description: Pulses is replaced by Pulses and Pulse flours in the lead article.
amendment_provisions.require: Identify exact pulse species and whether final powder is a pulse flour; independently verify current applicable lead threshold.

amendment_provisions.description: Pulses excluding soybean dry is replaced by Pulses and Pulse flours excluding soybean dry.
amendment_provisions.require: Check dry-soybean exclusion, botanical identity and processed flour identity; do not infer revised numeric limit.

amendment_provisions.description: Fish-oil-specific note specifies inorganic arsenic ML 0.1 mg/kg and total arsenic screening with conditional speciation follow-up.
amendment_provisions.require: Prove fish-oil finished article; assess total arsenic against 0.1 mg/kg then conduct validated inorganic arsenic testing when indicated. This screening note is prospective.

amendment_provisions.description: Revises source commodity text distinguishing oils and oilseeds for further processing from ready-to-eat oilseeds.
amendment_provisions.require: Confirm edible oil/oilseed and ready-to-eat versus further-processing status; no numeric toxin limit introduced by this manifest.

amendment_provisions.description: Revises corresponding oil/oilseed commodity wording for aflatoxin B1.
amendment_provisions.require: Review crop, state, sampling and exact aflatoxin B1 table row; do not transfer total-aflatoxin value.

amendment_provisions.description: Replaces the commodity entry with beverages and foods containing mace and/or nutmeg kernel as an ingredient, table value 10.
amendment_provisions.require: Require ingredient composition; neat mace/nutmeg spices are not automatically finished beverages/foods containing the spice as an ingredient.

amendment_provisions.description: Omits clause (1) of sub-regulation 2.3.2. Independent regulatory review of the deleted clause and implications is required.
amendment_provisions.require: Check legacy clause text and entire regulatory consequences across relevant products; 31 named watch points do not establish that other 502 products are unaffected.

amendment_provisions.description: Adds seafood including shrimp, prawns, fish/fishery products to trimethoprim row, value 0.05.
amendment_provisions.require: Verify seafood identity, drug-residue definition, unit, species, matrix and legal term; royal jelly/other animal products are not automatically seafood.

amendment_provisions.description: Adds oxolinic acid row for seafood including shrimp, prawns and fish/fishery products, value 0.3.
amendment_provisions.require: Verify specified drug and seafood article; do not transfer this to honey/royal jelly or unrelated veterinary contaminants.

families.description: From 1 December 2026: Lead 'Pulses' becomes 'Pulses and Pulse flours'; Cadmium 'Pulses, excluding soybean dry' becomes 'Pulses and Pulse flours, excluding soybean dry'.
families.specific_nontransfer_warning: Requires genuine pulse or pulse flour identity, and dry-soybean exclusion for cadmium.

families.description: A fish-oil-specific inorganic arsenic note applies from 1 December 2026: 0.1 mg/kg; total arsenic screening followed by inorganic arsenic determination where specified.
families.specific_nontransfer_warning: Fish-oil-specific arsenic speciation note; do not apply to fish meat or vegetable oil.

families.description: The article text for total aflatoxins and Aflatoxin B1 distinguishes oils and oilseeds for further processing from ready-to-eat oilseeds.
families.specific_nontransfer_warning: Requires ready-to-eat versus further processing decision; do not transfer source processing form.

families.description: Replaces the Saffrole naturally occurring toxic-substances entry with beverages and foods containing mace and/or nutmeg kernel as an ingredient; stated limit 10.
families.specific_nontransfer_warning: Ingredient-triggered clause. A neat spice is not automatically the named finished beverage/food containing it.

families.description: Adds seafood entries for Trimethoprim 0.05 and Oxolinic acid 0.3 in the Gazette table. The governing table unit, analyte/residue definition and legal sample basis must be checked before use.
families.specific_nontransfer_warning: Check whether processed sauce/curry/breaded product is legally within the listed seafood/fishery-products term; no direct drug MRL assigned here.

important_scope_limit: 31 explicit watch candidates are not an exhaustive amendment impact census. 502 have no named family flag, not a finding of non-applicability. Clause 2.3.2(1) omission needs separate impact analysis.
